name: Apostasine princes
description: The two brothers who rebelled against their sister and the church, starting the Apostasine Wars.

description_citations.text: "Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dead monarch's children split the kingdom; the sister refuses her brothers' demand to divide her inheritance and civil war erupts.
timeline.quote: She refused, and Alta Torrezon exploded into civil war.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The church declares the brothers heretics and the Apostasine Wars begin.
timeline.quote: Quickly, most of the church's leadership declared the brothers to be heretics, apostates who had turned from the divine plan to glorify themselves.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As defeat seems certain, Elenda charges into the apostate princes' guard and routs their army.
timeline.quote: Just as defeat seemed certain, a stranger emerged: wreathed in rippling black vapor, this rider charged into the honor guard of the apostate princes, slaughtering all in her path.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The monarch's death splits the kingdom and Alta Torrezon explodes into civil war in 803 BD.
timeline.quote: Alta Torrezon exploded into civil war.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 495 BD a stranger wreathed in black vapor routs the apostasine princes' army outside Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: wreathed in rippling black vapor, this rider charged into the honor guard of the apostate princes, slaughtering all in her path

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Gift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The two brothers who declared themselves apostasine princes and waged civil war on their sister and the church.
